_help: The library folders setup.sh makes (inside library/), and the folders Clip_Index.py indexes for footage (searched recursively): _internal content = everything Claude grabs, _external content = everything they bring (footage/ = the older name, still read). Each account's exports folder comes from library/profile.json. "resolve_menu": where Resolve_Export.py puts menu entries under Workspace > Scripts ({id}, {name}, {kind}, {batch}; a piece cut to a song goes in with_song, where {song} = the song's "menu" name or its title); "songs": where each song's markers entry goes (songs.py). "resolve_import": the library folders Resolve > Scripts > Import_Library mirrors as bins.
